name: Airbnb Stays
author: John Jahn
description: Find somewhere to stay without leaving your trip — search Airbnb for your dates, compare prices and ratings, and add the winner to the plan in one tap.

settings.label: This TREK server's URL
settings.hint: Needed by the "Register with OpenBnB" button, which lives on your own Settings → Plugins → Airbnb Stays card (TREK renders plugin buttons there, not in this admin form). Type the address your users reach TREK on, including any path it is hosted under, then Save — the button turns it into the OAuth redirect URI.

settings.label: OAuth authorize URL
settings.hint: Constant for the hosted OpenBnB service — type the greyed-out value exactly as shown. Change it only if you run your own OpenBnB.

settings.label: OAuth token URL
settings.hint: Constant for the hosted OpenBnB service — type the greyed-out value exactly as shown. Change it only if you run your own OpenBnB.

settings.label: OAuth client id
settings.hint: Go to Settings → Plugins → Airbnb Stays and press "Register with OpenBnB", then come back here and paste the client id it printed. Unique to this TREK instance. (Scripted alternative: `npm run register -- <your TREK URL>` in the plugin repo.)

settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.hint: From the same registration. Stored encrypted; never leaves this server.

settings.label: OpenBnB MCP endpoint
settings.hint: Optional. Leave blank to use the hosted OpenBnB service; the plugin falls back to the value shown.

settings.label: Map style

options.label: Esri grey canvas — matches TREK's basemap (default)
Custom tile server (fill in the three fields below)

settings.hint: Which basemap the "Where you'll be" map draws on. Leave unset for Esri's grey canvas, which needs no key and matches the basemap TREK draws its own maps on.

settings.label: Custom map tiles
settings.hint: Only read when Map style is Custom. Add the host under Allowed hosts too, or the tiles will not load.

settings.label: Custom map tiles (dark theme)
settings.hint: Only read when Map style is Custom. Leave blank to reuse the light tiles above on a dark theme.

settings.label: Custom map attribution
settings.hint: Leave blank and the credit follows whichever tile source is in use. Set it when you point the tiles at a provider the plugin does not recognise — publishing the wrong credit is a licensing problem, not a cosmetic one.

actions.label: Register with OpenBnB
actions.hint: Registers this server with OpenBnB and prints a client id and secret. Fill in "This TREK server's URL" under Admin → Plugins → Airbnb Stays → Instance settings and Save first; paste the two values back into that same form afterwards.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks this instance’s OpenBnB settings end to end and names the first thing that is wrong.
